drosophila_wing_epithelium_specimen.species: Apical junction-stained polygonal epithelial monolayer (green tight/adherens junction network with DAPI nuclei exhibiting hexagonal/pentagonal/heptagonal packing)

farhadifar_2007_vertex_energy_functional.section: Farhadifar et al. (2007) Current Biology 17(24):2095-2104, Eq. (1) & Eq. (2), pp. 2096-2098
farhadifar_2007_vertex_energy_functional.dimensional_energy_formula: E({r_i}) = sum_alpha (K_alpha / 2) * (A_alpha - A_alpha^(0))^2 + sum_{<i,j>} Lambda_{ij} * l_{ij} + sum_alpha (Gamma_alpha / 2) * L_alpha^2

dimensionless_parameters.regular_hexagon_perimeter_formula: L_6(A) = 2 * sqrt(2 * sqrt(3)) * sqrt(A) = sqrt(8 * sqrt(3) * A)

canonical_wing_disc_parameters.notes: Fitted in Farhadifar et al. (2007) Fig. 2A & Fig. 4 from polygon distribution P(n), area-side law <A_n>/<A>, and UV laser ablation of adherens junctions in 3rd-instar Drosophila wing imaginal discs.

ground_state_phase_regimes.label: Case I: Proliferating Wing Disc (Solid-like Hexagonal Ground State + Division Disorder)
Case I: Post-Mitotic Pupal Wing (Junctional Remodeling Hexagonal Packing)
Case I: High Cortical Contractility (Stiffened Perimeter Elasticity)
Case II: Soft / Fluid-like Network (Negative Line Tension, Vanishing T1 Barrier)

polygon_class_distributions.section: Farhadifar et al. (2007) Current Biology Fig. 3B & Fig. 4B; Gibson et al. (2006) Nature Fig. 1; Classen et al. (2005) Dev. Cell Fig. 1

lewis_law_area_topology.section: Lewis (1928) Anat. Rec. 38:341-376; Farhadifar et al. (2007) Current Biology Fig. 3C & Fig. 4C

pcp_hinge_contraction_reference.section: Pass 3 (v3) planar-cell-polarity / hinge-contraction reference values. All numeric values in this block are APPROXIMATE figure reads recorded offline; none was re-verified online in Pass 3 and they must be treated as provisional until a Pass 4 digitisation.

model_statement.fz_stbm_bridge_density: c_ab = relu(p_a.n) relu(p_b.n) + relu(-p_a.n) relu(-p_b.n), n = outward bond normal of cell a, p = Frizzled (distal) polarity unit vector
model_statement.bond_asymmetry_tensor: Q_ab = 2 c_ab (n (x) n - I/2) (traceless symmetric); a_ab = n.Q_ab.n = 2 c_ab - 1 = cos(2 theta_n) for uniform polarity
model_statement.bond_tension: Lambda_ab = Lambda_bar (1 + eps_pcp a_ab); eps_pcp = 0 is the fz / stbm loss-of-function (isotropic) control
model_statement.polarity_dynamics: dphi_a/dt = k_fb <sin(phi_b - phi_a)>_b + k_flow min(|Q_a|/0.15, 1) sin(2(psi_a - phi_a)) + noise
model_statement.hinge_contraction: boundary vertices follow F(t) = diag(lambda(t), 1/lambda(t)), ln lambda ramped (smoothstep) to hinge_log_strain over the first half of the run
model_statement.shear_decomposition: ln lambda(t) = d<Q_xx>(t) + residual(t); residual attributed to T1 rearrangements (post-mitotic patch: no division / extrusion / correlation terms)

cell_elongation_peak_Q.locus: Fig. 3 (blade cell-elongation nematic Q, peak near 22 hAPF)

rearrangement_shear_fraction_end.locus: Fig. 3 shear decomposition at ~32 hAPF (cell rearrangements carry roughly half of the cumulative PD blade shear)

classen_2005_pupal_P6.locus: Fig. 1 / Fig. 7 polygon distributions of wild-type vs fz / stbm pupal wings (~30 hAPF)

tension_anisotropy_note.statement: Sugimura & Ishihara (2013) infer anisotropic junction tension in the pupal wing under hinge contraction and show that anisotropic tension promotes hexagonal ordering; no numeric anisotropy value is vendored here.
